turns.text: Sergeant-at-Arms is directed to make a proclamation.

turns.speaker: Alfredo Sotto Corpuz
turns.text: All persons are commanded to keep silent under pain of penalty while the Impeachment Court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order. We shall be led in prayer by Senator-Judge Alan Peter Cayetano.

turns.speaker: Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano
turns.text: 2 Chronicles 7:14. If my people who are called by my name will humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways, then I will hear from heaven and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land. Lord, many, many, many years ago, Lord Father God, Your people in Egypt thought they were forgotten, thought that they were worthless, thought that whether it is their culture, their actions, or kung simpleng kapalaran lang nila ang maging slaves po. Ang maging isang nation na hindi nakikita po ang pag-asa. But from a child who will be killed to the son of the Pharaoh, back to being a shepherd, you sent Moses. But Lord God, the 7 to 14 days journey from Egypt to the Promised Land, the 7 to 14 day journey from slavery to conquerors, turned out to be 40 years. It is said that this is so not because only of disobedience, but because one generation refused to think. Like conquerors, refused to submit to you but rather had that slave mentality. Even claiming in the desert that it is better to go back to Egypt because at least there is food and drink. Lord Father, it is 2026 and we are faced with an economic crisis, not only the Philippines, the whole world. We're faced with a crisis with our democracy, facing many, many corruption issues. We are faced with issues of accountability from the president to the vice president all the way down, Lord God, to our barangays. Lord, in 1906, after almost 400 years of Spanish rule, you decreed that we shift in our courts from Spanish to English. Exactly 40 years later, Lord God, we left the Commonwealth of the United States of America. to be an independent nation. Exactly 40 years more, we had the first peaceful people power revolution in the world. Lord, every 40 years it seems you have freed us for something and allowed us to conquer and enter. Lord, we pray that in 2026 you will make things clear to us despite our political persuasions.

turns.speaker: Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano
turns.text: We pray that you protect the integrity of this court.

turns.speaker: Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano
turns.text: Not

turns.speaker: Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano
turns.text: only inside

turns.speaker: Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano
turns.text: this court, but external factors, Lord, even pressures targeted, Lord, not only at both parties, at the prosecution and the defense, but also at the senator-judges. We lift up to you our nation, Lord God, and humble ourselves. We pray that you will heal this land. In Jesus' mighty name. Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Amen.

turns.speaker: Atty. Lindon Miguel C. Bacquel

For the record, in TSN dated November 25, 2024, page 101 thereof, the intended witness stated, Your Honor, as part po ng trabaho niya po, iyon eh, kasi confidential operation po. turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles
turns.text: Your Honor, there are numerous instances when that was discussed and in two other instances, Mr. Fajarda said that he merely turned over the funds.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Reynaldo Robles

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: can we agree that Colonel Nolasco received the funds from Fajarda?

Number 4 At least 37 of those single match names were already dead. 32 mula sa OVP at 5 sa DepEd. Lahat may certificate of death sa CRS. turns.text: Ms. Grande, kasama sa inyong mga katungkulan bilang Assistant National Statistician ang pagbe-verify ng mga Civil Registry documents. Ngayon, Ms. Grande, paano po ba bine-verify ng PSA ang mga Civil Registry documents?

turns.text: Ang pag-verify po ng mga requests for civil registry documents ay dumadaan po sa apat na proseso po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Ano po itong apat na proseso na ito na inyong nabanggit?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yung una pong phase, ito yung pag-receive ng mga requests coming from different agencies at pag-route po dun sa appropriate office within the PSA, Civil Registration Service. Yung pangalawa po ay pag-verify ng mga Request of CRD civil registry documents gamit yung mga information na i-provide using the CRS database. At pangatlo po yung pag-consolidate ng lahat ng mga Verification results at pag-prepare ng official reply. Yung pang-apat po na phase, ito yung final review and approval ng mga appropriate signatories. In this case po, yung National Statistician and Civil Registrar General at yung pag-transmit sa requesting agency po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: By the way, Ms. Grande, kailan po kayo nagsimulang manungkulan bilang Assistant National Statistician?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Ako po ay na-appoint noong August 30, 2022 ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Bago po kayo naitalaga bilang Assistant National Statistician, ano po ang inyong trabaho kung meron man?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Ako po ay humawak na ng iba't ibang posisyon na may kinalaman po sa civil registration tsaka vital statistics.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Ano

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: po itong mga katungkulan na ito?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Sa aking pong pagseserbisyo sa NSO tsaka sa PSA, ako po ay naging Division Chief, Registration Officer 5, Registration Officer 4, Archivist 2, at saka yung mga statistician positions, Stat 1 po and statistician aide.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Ms. Grande, nabanggit niyo po na marami na kayong mga katungkulan na hinawakan pareho sa NSA ngayon ay PSA. So, Ms. Grande, ilang taon na po kayong naninilbihan or nanunungkulan sa NSO now PSA?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: I've been in the service for more than 25 years na po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Ngayon, Ms. Grande, again, isa rin po sa inyong katungkulan ay pag-manage ng mga civil registry documents. Paano naman po minamanage ang mga civil registry documents na ito ng PSA?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Ang PSA po bilang central repository ng lahat ng documents ay merong civil registry system po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Maaari niyo po bang ipaliwanag sa amin kung ano po itong Civil Registry System?

turns.text: Ang Civil Registry System po ng PSA ay siya pong nagsisilbi bilang central repository ng lahat ng mga Documents na nareceive namin coming from the local civil registry offices. Kasama na rin po dito yung mga vital events na nire-report ng mga Philippine Foreign Service posts abroad. At saka yung mga Muslim divorces and including yung mga conversions and marriages po sa Sharia.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: To be precise, Ms. Grande, ano-ano po itong mga dokumentong ito?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Ang naka-store po sa ating PSACRS database yung mga vital events such as births, marriages, and deaths. Kasama na rin po yung ibang registrable documents affected po ng mga court orders at administrative corrections po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Okay, Ms. Grande, bukod po sa kinakailangan ito sa ilalim ng batas, bakit po mahalaga na mairehistro ang mga kapanganakan, kasal, at pagkamatay?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Ang pagpaparehistro ng births, marriages, and deaths ay mandatory po under Act 3753. Ito yung the Civil Registry Law. At kinakailangan po ito, number one, primarily as a proof of legal identity. At pangalawa po, ang lahat po ng mga registrable documents ay kailangang ipasa sa PSA at nagsisilbi ang mga certified copies na ini-issue po ng aming tanggapan bilang pagpapatunay at sa pag-transact sa iba't ibang government or private na transactions.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Bangit niyo po na kinakailangan itong mga dokumentong ito sa mga transactions. Ano naman po itong mga transactions na ito?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Karaniwan po sa pag-request ng mga civil registry documents, ang mga purpose po nila ay either ito ay gamit sa pag-enroll, school enrollment, pag-a-apply sa trabaho or passport, at iba pang pag nag-a-apply po sila ng mga valid identification card. at saka iba-iba pang purposes po para sa mga personal na transactions sa gobyerno o kaya sa private po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Kanina po, Ms. Grande, may inilahad kayo na four-phase process. Ano naman po ang inyong personal na participation dito sa prosesong ito?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Balik po ulit tayo dun sa request ng inyong verification.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Ano po ang ginawa nitong PSA? Matapos i-conduct yung re-verification na nagresulta sa pagkakahanap ninyo ng mga minors base sa talaan na ibinigay ng House of Representatives.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: So kagaya po nung binanggit ko following yung standard verification, nag-issue po kami ng letter and yung listahan ng mga verified results ng aming verification at gayon din po yung mga certified copies ng mga civil registry documents based po doon sa resulta ng aming verification.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Noted, Ms. Mae.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Thank you your honor. May I again invite your attention

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: To the screen. May pinapakita po ulit ako sa inyo mga pangalan. Magsimula po tayo sa pangalang Miko Alquizar. Ano po bang kinalaman nitong pangalan na ito dun sa mga pangalang nire-verify ninyo pursuant to the June 25, 2026 letter request na nagmula sa House of Representatives.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ma'am Marizza, bago po tayo magpatuloy, naunawaan niyo [unclear] patuloy na magbibigay [unclear] inyong testimonya [unclear] niyo pong panunumpa na magsasabi ng katotohanan at pawang katotohanan lamang. Naunawaan niyo po yan?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes po, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Salamat po. Attorney Justin, your witness for your cross.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Thank you, Your Honor. Turning to my cross, Your Honor. Magandang hapon po, Ms. Grande.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Good afternoon, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Ms. Grande, during your direct examination, you stated that you are the assistant national statistician of the Civil Registration Service of the PSA, correct?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And in that position, Ms. Grande, this is not the first time that you testified under oath in relation to the impeachment of the Vice President, correct?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: You recall that you testified before the Committee of Justice of the House of Representatives back on April 14, 2026.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. And in that hearing, Ms. Grande, before the Committee on Justice, you confirmed, as you testified, that you are in charge of the verification, processing, and archiving of civil registry documents in the Philippine Statistics Authority or the PSA.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And you are also in charge in the generation of vital statistics. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At ilang taon na po kayo sa PSA?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: More than 25 years, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Nung direct examination niyo po kay Atty. Mae, nag-identify po kayo ng ilan na mga PSA certifications. Yung tanong ko po, ito po yung mga resulta ng verification process na sinagawa ng PSA. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Tama, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And this verification process that the PSA conducted used the Civil Registry System database of the PSA itself, correct?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And the civil registry system database is considered as the centralized or national repository of all our civil registry documents in the Philippines. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Correct sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At ang laman po nito ay ang mga sinusumite ng ating mga local civil registry offices. Tama?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Kasama na po yung mga syariah courts natin. Tama?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Kasama na rin po yung mga Philippine Foreign Service Posts natin. Tama?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes po, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So, is it therefore correct to say, Ms. Grande, that the CRS database of our PSA relies on the submissions of these offices?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: That's correct, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: In other words, once these offices submit civil registry documents or information to the PSA, The PSA then enters the information and documents in the database, correct?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And this CRS database is an electronic database, would that be correct?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, the PSA does not conduct field investigations to verify whether all births in the country is registered. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Partly yes sir for the CRS but there are other like for example in the census. where we gather information on birth registration.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Allow me to repeat the question po, Ma'am Grande. Particularly for the CRS, does the PSA conduct field investigations to physically check whether rehestrado lahat ng mga births dito sa Pilipinas?

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Already asked and answered, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Your Honor, I'm just asking a clarification.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Witness will answer. She did not answer clearly the first time.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir. We rely on the submission of the local civil registry offices on the registration including the post and the sharia. But as the PSA is also in charge in the censuses, we get information also on the birth registration.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes. And tama din po with respect to the CRS database. Hindi po nagko-conduct yung PSA natin ng field investigation to investigate whether all deaths, I'm referring to deaths, Atty. Mae, in the country is registered.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir. We do study as to the completeness based on the available censuses and the vital statistics.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: So,

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: estimate kami, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Sorry, Ms. Grande, for interrupting you. But my next question is, and similarly, The PSA also does not conduct any field investigations in relation to the CRS database to physically check whether all marriages in the Philippines are recorded, correct?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: For that, sir, yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: But you do confirm, Ms. Grande, ma'am, na nagko-conduct po naman yung PSA ng mga registration programs?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir. We have the birth registration assistance project we launched in February 2022.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes. And the reason why we have these registration programs is because, admittedly, not all births are recorded in the Philippines. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Sir, yes. Registration is not universal. That's why we have programs to register all para sa universal civil registration.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Meron po ba tayong ginagawa na similar with respect to deaths? Nagre-registration program din po ba tayo?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Mga IECs lang po because there are areas lang that we identified based on the census and in some of the indirect estimates na may low registration rates.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So you confirm based on the census available to the PSA that not all deaths in the country are also registered?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Sorry sir, for the deaths po, indirect estimates meaning hindi po siya sa census. Sa census kasi birth registration lang po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay, let me rephrase my question. Ma'am, so hindi po makukumperma ng PSA na recorded o rehistrado lahat ng pagkakamatay. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes po, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And in the same manner, the PSA hindi din kayang ikuperma kung lahat ng mga kasalan sa Pilipinas ay nakarehistrado sa sistema niyo. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes for now, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes. Now, so you confirm that it is possible that a certain birth did in fact occur but it is not registered in the CRS database.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Based on the data po, there are births not registered.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And you do confirm that it is also possible that a death had in fact occurred but it is not registered in your database.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, there are deaths na unregistered but there are process also to reconstruct or to file the late registration.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Maraming salamat, ma'am. I'll take that answer. And you also confirm na posible din po, ma'am, na may marriage that was celebrated pero hindi rehistarado sa CRS database natin?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes po, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Now, you do confirm, Ms. Grande, na meron din tayong cases na tinatawag na late registration. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Meron tayong late registration sa mga births or sa mga pagpanganag.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Meron din tayong mga late registration sa deaths or sa mga pagkamatay. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Tama po, Sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Meron din po tayong mga late registration sa marriages at sa mga kasalan na nangyayari. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And tama po ba na kapag hindi pa sila rehestrado kasi nga late, hindi din ito lalabas sa CRS database natin?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Agree, Sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, next. You mentioned during your direct examination that in your verification process, You inputted the information provided by the House of Representatives. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes. Now, my question now is in your verification process, tama po ba that clerical errors can also affect searches in your database?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Not exactly, sir, because our CRS is designed in such a way that when you verify a particular record, makukuha mo pa rin yung Even though clerical error yung name and also those with similar sounds sa name or sa last name. Kaya ang sagot ko sir, not exactly dahil maka-capture mo pa rin sa system namin.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Pero it is possible, ma'am.

turns.speaker: Atty. Mae Sancho Divinagracia
turns.text: Already asked and answered, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: My question is different, Your Honor. I am confirming whether it is possible which is within the personal knowledge.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Our RSO verifiers po, are following query parameters. So may iba-iba pong level yan. That all, for example, when you input a name, kahit po wrong yung spelling niya, all of the entries which is almost similar to that name will be provided. At isa-isahin po yun ng aming RSO verifier. So kaya yung sagot ko po doon is not exactly because Our system is parang flexible siya to provide you all the names. For example, yung Piatos, sir. All the Piatos na last name plus the M, for example, na name.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay, but in fact, Madam Witness, if you recall during the April 14, 2026 hearing before the Committee on Justice, do you recall having making this statement, and I quote, I cannot say na 100% accurate iyong negative results. Do you recall making that statement?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: I recall, sir, that they are inquiring on whether na-exhaust yung verification. And I think I said that we have exhausted based on the information that is provided.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yes. Let me counsel. Ms. Grande, you did not answer the question. The question was, do you recall making that statement that you have read, na hindi 100% accurate yung negative results?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir. Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Okay. Thank you, Your Honor. Let's proceed po, Ms. Grande. Now, let's go back to the certifications. During the House of Representatives committee hearing on April 14, tama po ba that you attended that hearing as a representative of Dr. Claire Dennis Mapa?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande

turns.text: Now, these certifications were issued by the PSA as you mentioned upon the request of the House of Representatives Committee of Good Government and Public Accountability, correct?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Ito po yung mga cover letter na [unclear] at [unclear] ni Undersecretary [unclear] Mapa, correct?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Puntahan po natin yung December 8, 2024 na cover letter to the certification dated December 8, 2024. You confirm that the same refers to, and I quote, Madam Grande, the request for verification of civil registry documents of 677 individuals.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: [unclear] omnibus certification with the results of verification on the documents of the listed individuals from the Philippine Statistics Authority Civil Registry System Database on the basis of the information provided for your reference.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.text: Now,

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: my question is, in relation to that certification dated December 8, 2024, who gave or who provided the PSA with that information?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: The list was provided by the Committee on Good Government and Public Accountability.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Maraming salamat po, Ms. Grande. Puntahan na naman natin yung cover letter December 11, 2024. to the certification dated December 11, 2024.

turns.text: May we request the tech booth to please zoom.

turns.text: Do you also have it with you, Madam Grande?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Now, it also contains the same last paragraph, correct?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes. And again, the same question, who provided you with the information subject of that certification?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: It's the Committee on Good Government and Public Accountability.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And you mentioned earlier when you answered me, nakabase po ito sa information, ito po yung listahan na binigay ng House of Representatives.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes po, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So, am I correct that besides that list that was provided to you, the House of Representatives did not provide you with any other documents, correct?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: It's just the list, sir, and the letter request.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: It means that when the House of Representatives made this request to the Philippine Statistics Authority, it also did not furnish the PSA with the copies of the acknowledgement receipts, correct?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So, apart from the list, and this is a different question, did the PSA use any other material in conducting its verification process using its CRS database?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: No, sir. We just used the list for the verification.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Maraming salamat po, Ms. Grande. Now, I went over those PSA certifications. And if you can look at the right portion thereof, may mga sinabing mga paragraphs na negative record. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Meron ding mga sinasabi na most likely match, correct?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At sinabi mo kanina kapag negative record, hindi nakita sa CRS database, correct?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes po, sir.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Kapag most likely match, pwedeng isa yung nag-match or single entry, correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: At

turns.text: marami yung nag-match multiple entry. Is that correct?

turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: However, you confirm, if makikita niyo po sa dokumento na yan, please confirm that these certifications do not say that the listed persons do not exist. You confirm that? Walang sinasabi dyan?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Wala pong sinasabi sa certification namin about the existence, only the attestation as to the availability po ng records sa database.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So, my question now is, These certifications only say that particular names are not found in the CSR database. Yan lang po yung ibig sabihin yan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Counsel,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero

turns.text: CRS. Pardon. And thank you, Your Honor, for correcting me.

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Yes, sir. It's only based sa verification namin in the CRS database.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And

turns.text: again, based on the information given by the House of Representatives, Committee of Good Government, and Public Accountability. Correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: Yes. So when the PSA certification state negative record ma'am, hindi na po siya nagsa-certify na walang tao na nag-exist na ganyan. Tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: Again sir, I will repeat that we are testifying as to the availability po ng record and not as to the existence.

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: So to clarify, it only certifies that a particular name is not found in the CRS database. Correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: And the

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular

turns.text: Now,

turns.speaker: Atty. Justin Nicol B. Gular
turns.text: puntahan po natin

turns.text: And you do confirm that there are birth certifications contained in the certification that you submitted?

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande

turns.speaker: Marizza B. Grande
turns.text: of Representatives.

turns.text: Based

turns.text: po dun sa re-verification namin in the December and then also in June of 2026. Since we conducted the verification, they have the same results.
